summary: Senior Software Engineer with 11+ years of experience building and operating production systems in Scala/JVM. Strong background in distributed systems, large-scale data processing, PostgreSQL/SQL and Kafka, with hands-on experience in CI/CD, Docker and Kubernetes. Experienced in taking data-intensive backend systems from initial design to production and long-term technical ownership. Pragmatic, autonomous and comfortable learning new technologies and domains.

experience.description: Designed and built distributed backend services and data-intensive systems for an open-source Layer 1 blockchain. Led the Explorer Backend from initial design to long-term production ownership, continuously ingesting, processing and indexing 100M+ blocks plus transactions and associated data, representing several hundred million PostgreSQL records. Worked extensively on data modeling, SQL query optimization, indexing and production performance.
